review.vietnamese: Re-cut against word starts in the original YouTube CC track. Automatic CC includes recognition errors; display text corrects obvious spelling and is not a certified verbatim transcript.
review.khmer: Selected complete short Khmer phrases from the original YouTube CC, with working Vietnamese translations and word-start evidence. Greeting is used at intro, started at go, congratulations only at a player win. No source team names in these selected CC phrases. No independent listening/native-language verification.
review.percussion: Recorded field transients during a gap in recognised commentary; filtered and faded, not isolated studio drum stems.
review.rights: Source attributed to broadcaster. No permission or reusable-content licence has been independently verified.
review.speakers: Only source broadcast audio; no TTS, cloning, replacement narrator, pitch shift or time stretch. YouTube CC does not identify speakers; Vietnamese/Khmer speaker roles follow the two-commentator reference supplied by the user.
review.teamNames: Name identities were matched manually against the registration roster, local aliases and surrounding race/team context in automatic CC. Original speech only; no assembled syllables, invented team numbers or runtime TTS. Shared pagoda-name cuts contain no gender/entry claim; numbered cuts are used only for that number. Proper-name spelling in automatic CC can be wrong; this is not independent listening verification.
review.teamHistory: Only complete original commentary phrases with externally corroborated 2024 results. Historical standings are restricted to the identified entry/gender, never used to decide a game result. Missing names/history remain explicitly unavailable; absent CC is not proof the audio never speaks that name.
